cream-paper.$description: Cream Paper — Page canvas, soft section background — warm off-white with a barely-there pink cast, never pure white

pure-card.$description: Pure Card — Card surfaces, elevated panels, button text on violet fills

ash-mist.$description: Ash Mist — Tertiary surface, muted dividers, subtle background washes

carbon-black.$description: Carbon Black — Primary text, default borders, icon strokes — the structural ink of the system

graphite-input.$description: Graphite Input — Input field borders, secondary dark surfaces

obsidian-pill.$description: Obsidian Pill — Dark CTA fill — the secondary action button (e.g. Reserve), pairs with white text and violet shadow

electric-violet.$description: Electric Violet — Primary accent — link borders, active states, icon highlights, section accent borders. The brand's signal color

lilac-pill.$description: Lilac Pill — Primary CTA button fill — the dominant call-to-action, sits on violet hard shadow with black text

deep-plum.$description: Deep Plum — Dark violet text variant, deep accent borders, section-level emphasis when Electric Violet feels too bright

shadow-plum.$description: Shadow Plum — Violet supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

acid-lime.$description: Acid Lime — Sparingly used highlight wash or accent surface for urgency moments (limited drops, reservation states)

signal-blue.$description: Signal Blue — Outlined action border — secondary ghost button or informational outline accent

abccameraplainvariable.$description: Primary UI and display typeface — handles body, headings, navigation, and product copy

serialc-heavy.$description: Uppercase eyebrows, button text, section labels, mono-influenced captions

serialc.$description: SerialC — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
